newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical has supply contract with AmeriNet. [CORRECTED 17:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical has supply contract with AmeriNet. [CORRECTED 17:55 GMT]

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp. said Thursday it has a five-year contract as AmeriNet Inc.'s sole provider of stapling, laparoscopic and suture products, estimated to generate sales of about $100 million a year.
U.S. Surgical's stock fell (corrects from rose) $1.625 to $32.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
The contract, which follows a similar deal signed in 1986, is effective as of June 1 and covers more than 2,000 hospitals for which AmeriNet provides group purchasing services, the company said.
AmeriNet, a closely held company based in St. Louis, has more than 6,000 members in 50 states and sales of $3.2 billion annually, it said.
U.S. Surgical, based in Norwalk, Conn., specialises in minimally invasive surgical products.
